table.retrieve:
SELECT currlistrow = 0,
			stock     = 0, 
			totalstock= 0, 
			TD.transcode,
			TD.icode, 
			I.customicode,
			TH.posted,
         TH.dgcode,
			remarks=max(TH.remarks),
         TH.sgcode,
          sourcegodown=(SELECT  GC.NAME FROM GODOWN GC WHERE GC.GCODE=TH.sgcode),
          targetgodown=(SELECT  GD.NAME FROM GODOWN GD WHERE GD.GCODE=TH.dgcode),
         itemname = I.name, 
         Id   = TD.IDENTITYCOL,
			requiredqty =(SELECT IC.goptimumqty * IC.packunits FROM  item IC WHERE IC.icode=TD.icode )  - ISNULL((SELECT sum(currqty) FROM  godowndetail G WHERE G.icode=TD.icode AND G.gcode=TH.dgcode),0) ,
			reorderqty = (SELECT IC.greorderqty * IC.packunits FROM  item IC WHERE IC.icode=TD.icode ) ,
			optimumqty = (SELECT IC.goptimumqty * IC.packunits FROM  item IC WHERE IC.icode=TD.icode ) ,
			targetstk = ISNULL((SELECT sum(currqty) FROM  godowndetail G WHERE G.icode=TD.icode AND G.gcode=TH.dgcode),0) ,
		sourcestk = ISNULL((SELECT sum(currqty) FROM  godowndetail G WHERE G.icode=TD.icode AND G.gcode=TH.sgcode) ,0),
			qty  = sum(TD.qty),
			headerno=max(TH.headerno)

    FROM tdetail TD, theader TH, 
         item  I

   WHERE (TH.transcode = :ar_tCode) AND
         ( TD.transcode = TH.transcode )    AND
		   ( TD.icode = I.icode )
         
GROUP BY TD.transcode, 
			TH.sgcode,
         TH.dgcode,
         TH.posted,
         TD.icode, 
			I.customicode, 
			I.name,
         Id
			
ORDER BY Id

objects.name: posted
objects.format: case(  posted  when "Y" then '(Posted)' when "N" then '(UnPosted)')
